messages.content: "請問你能告訴我籃球隊'洛杉磯湖人'在'NBA'聯盟的最新比分、個人球員數據和球隊數據嗎？同時，我也想知道足球隊'曼徹斯特聯足球俱樂部'在'英超聯賽'的相同信息。此外，你能提供紐約未來5天的濕度預報嗎，確保最低濕度水平為60％？最後，我也想知道倫敦未來7天的濕度預報，但不需要任何最低濕度水平過濾。"

function.name: weather_humidity_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a humidity forecast for a specific location and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the humidity for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

min_humidity.description: Minimum level of humidity (in percentage) to filter the result. Default is 0.

function.name: get_team_score
function.description: Retrieves the latest game score, individual player stats, and team stats for a specified sports team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league that the team is part of.

include_player_stats.description: Indicates if individual player statistics should be included in the result. Default is false.

message.reasoning: The user wants multiple requests: basketball team Lakers in NBA, football team Manchester United in Premier League, humidity forecast for New York 5 days min 60%, humidity forecast for London 7 days no filter. We have two functions: weather_humidity_forecast and get_team_score. We need to call get_team_score twice? The function signature includes team_name, league, include_player_stats optional. For each request we can call get_team_score with include_player_stats true. Then call weather_humidity_forecast twice: first with location "New York", days 5, min_humidity 60; second with location "London", days 7, no min_humidity. We need to output function calls. The user wants all info. We can do separate calls. Probably best to call get_team_score twice, then weather_humidity_forecast twice.
